result.title: Test TEST-MCP-USECASE-020
result.description: For each sixteenth-review finding (TR-MCP-USECASE-019), write the consumer-facing test and the real operating-system, mount, provider, process, or evidence-boundary test with scripted data first and prove them against that data in a green mock gate with negative controls before production changes (BDPv4: no red tests); then bind the same cases to production and prove focused and cumulative GREEN from C:-physical artifacts with exact zero-failure, zero-skip, zero-abort, zero-inconclusive, and expected-minimum accounting. Platform-specific cases are integration tests that run in their host's lane (TR-MCP-NUKE-019).
